vegetable-garden: The Vidyalaya hosts a vegetable garden where students grow farm fresh seasonal vegetables using organic manure and pesticides. The vegetables after harvesting are sold within the campus.
herbal-garden: Within the campus a herbal garden with varieties of medicinal plants labelled with their scientific and common names is also present, which enables the students to get firsthand knowledge of these traditional herbs and trees and their use in household remedies as cure for various ailments.
nakshathravanam: 'Nakshatravanam' is another major attraction within the campus where plants representing Birth Stars are grown in pots . A detailed knowledge about the plant belonging to each birth star along with their scientific and common names is also displayed. 'Dasapushpangal' constituting of ten flowers holding a prominent position in Kerala tradition are also grown here.
